decision: Keep disabled. The call/return candidate passes the 2% gate on all six workloads (fib 0.678, closures 0.860, records 0.797, tables 0.984, loops 0.942, strings 0.989) but the cold compiler check still regresses (43.79 s to 46.55 s median of three; warm 0.608 s to 0.616 s). Lookup and helper paths are next; promotion needs the compiler regression gone and broader coverage.
method: 12 paired independent processes per xbench candidate; alternating AB/BA; best-of-three inside each process; geometric mean paired ratio and 10000 paired bootstrap draws, 95% interval. Timing candidates and compiler checks ran serially.
